method: Income-statement line 'Other income' was SAR 536.1m in FY2025 vs SAR 0.1m in FY2024 (= 12.8 pp of FY2024 TOI; reported TOI growth 14.7%). It arose in Q4 2025 (9M2025 other income SAR 0.9m) and did not recur (9M2026: SAR 2.3m). The filing gives no explanation and does not label it non-recurring, so it is not removed.
assumptions: If it were non-recurring, TOI growth excluding it would be 1.9% (our calculation, not adopted).
notes: Same year: disposals of other real estate (repossessed collateral) with carrying amount SAR 265.9m (note 30c, p.77); the segment note books SAR 657m of other operating income in corporate banking (p.64). No link between these is disclosed.
